tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: First, describe any past experience you have with writing. Do you enjoy it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：首先，请描述一下你过去有什么写作经历。你喜欢写作吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Some people find writing diaries very helpful. Do you have the habit of writing diaries?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。有些人觉得写日记非常有帮助。你有写日记的习惯吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some universities require students to take writing courses every semester. Do you think it's a good idea?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。有些大学要求学生每学期都上写作课。你认为这是个好主意吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, do you agree or disagree with the following statement? “Strong writing skills are more important for career success than public speaking skills.” Use details and examples to support your opinion.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得有道理。最后，你是同意还是不同意以下说法？“扎实的写作能力比公众演讲能力对职业成功更重要。” 请用具体细节和例子来支持你的观点
tasks.title: Interview
